n: Day of AI Kindergarten: Machines All Around Us
t: A two-lesson kindergarten unit on machines and the sensors they use.
steps: Go to dayofai.org and find the Kindergarten Machines All Around Us unit.
Register or log in. The page says a login is needed to view all resources.
Open the slide deck or the Google Slides copy.
Read the Educator Guide for both lessons.
Download and print the student resources.
Teach What Is a Machine first and How Do Machines Sense the World second.
